determinacy.why: Whether Paris landmarks follow the capital depends on how the model stores them: as facts about Paris they stay in Paris, as facts about the capital of France they move to Lyon. The functional and inverse queries come out the same either way.

assumes: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris.
The Élysée Palace is in Paris.
worlds.summary: Landmarks are stored against the city by name, so they stay in Paris.

assumes: The Eiffel Tower is in the capital of France.
The Élysée Palace is in the capital of France.
worlds.summary: Landmarks are stored against the capital of France, so they move to Lyon with it.
